subject: Confirmed: e2e/fixtures.ts consoleErrors fails on the Trusted Types report-only lines (all of ink.spec on WebKit)
body: Local run on fb99501 + my test fix, WebKit iPad portrait/landscape and phone 390: 18 ink.spec failures, all 'Error: console errors' with one '[Report Only] This requires a TrustedScriptURL value…' line each, raised by e2e/fixtures.ts:139. So the shared console guard needs the report-only filter. I'm not editing fixtures.ts (seg22, it's yours). ink-sync.spec has its own collector, which I've already filtered.
